reviews.review_msg: If over 70% of students leave halfway through class after a quiz, maybe consider how uninspiring lectures are. claims hard work went into slides and it just summarizes TB. Withholding slides because students don't attend is not a part of the syllabus

If you're gonna send out an email complaining that no one's attending your classes then maybe the way you teach is the problem. Make the lectures engaging. Making it so u have to ask questions in lecture for marks more people would come.  this backfired since if there's a chance she doesn't pick ur hand u lose marks. So you might as well not go.

Mandatory lectures but lecture material rarely shows up on tests. The textbook for this class is what the tests are built off of. She expects everyone to go but her lectures consist of Q&A slides that almost never show up on the exams. The 400 page textbook is mandatory to have and is basically what the tests go off of. Nice person though.

Avoid at all cost. Don't get me wrong, she's really passionate and knowledgeable. She LOVES her research, and she puts in a lot of effort in the lecture slides. She also makes sure your questions get answered. However, covering a WHOLE TEXTBOOK 400pg in 13 weeks is not what the students deserved. 2 midterms,1final,5 in-class writing assignment.
